newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France Feb 97 cargo traffic up 6.7pct.
newsitem.headline: Air France Feb 97 cargo traffic up 6.7pct.

text.p: Air France recorded a 6.7 percent increase in cargo traffic in February 1997, with 390 million freight tonne kilometres (FTK), figures from the French national carrier show.
The FTK measurement is derived by multiplying the weight of cargo carried by the distance flown.
The overall cargo load factor in February 1997 was up 2.9 percentange points on the same month the previous year at 73.7 percent, the airline said.
In the first 11 months of its current financial year - which runs from April 1 1996 to March 31 1997 - Air France carried 4.41 billion FTK, up six percent on April 1995-February 1996.

The overall cargo load factor during April 1996-February 1997 was up 0.7 percentage points on the same period the previous year at 68.9 percent, the airline added. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44-171-542-7706 Fax+5017
